mechanism: Ginkgo biloba may induce CYP3A4 and CYP2C9, potentially reducing efavirenz concentrations, while efavirenz may inhibit ginkgo's metabolism, and both agents carry CNS and bleeding risks.
action: Monitor efavirenz efficacy and viral load; consider therapeutic drug monitoring; counsel on bleeding precautions and CNS effects; consider alternative antiretroviral if efavirenz levels become subtherapeutic.
